title: AfOx Graduate Scholarships (2027-28 Oxford MBA)
institution: Saïd Business School, University of Oxford
about: Oxford's Saïd Business School offers up to three AfOx Graduate Scholarships for the 2027-28 MBA to African nationals resident in Africa, covering course fees and a living-costs grant. Submit the MBA application by Stage 4, 6 January 2027.
requirements: African nationals, ordinarily resident in African countries, who can demonstrate a commitment to Africa's development
No separate scholarship form: submit the MBA application by the deadline
Applicants wanting University of Oxford scholarship consideration must apply by the January (Stage 4) deadline

upskill.name: AI for Leaders
why: No course objective covers the stated requirements ("African nationals, ordinarily resident in African countries, who can demonstrate a commitment to Africa's development"; "submit the MBA application by the deadline"), which are eligibility and admissions conditions rather than skills; shortlist matches were incidental stems ("busines", "can", "no", "application"), not genuine objective matches.

Field "Business administration (MBA)" → AI for Leaders Academy (courses for executives and managers, e.g. A006.02 "AI Strategy & Competitive Advantage"), so the caption links to the Academy page, not a specific course.
